package rulefixtures

import (
	"io/ioutil"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for ioutil_readall_still_used: `ioutil.ReadAll` usage when `io.ReadAll` is available (Go 1.16+)
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func readRequestBody(r *http.Request) ([]byte, error) {
	defer r.Body.Close()
	return ioutil.ReadAll(r.Body)
}

func loadFile(path string) ([]byte, error) {
	data, err := ioutil.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return data, nil
}
